# CANDIDATE: VWAP_GAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that fails to hold above VWAP often fills back to VWAP, providing a mean-reverting long opportunity. This edge exists because initial gap-up momentum frequently exhausts, allowing price to revert to the intraday VWAP as a dynamic fair value reference, especially in moderate volatility regimes where mean reversion is stronger than trend persistence.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the opening gap up exceeds 0.3% of the prior close and price is above VWAP at the open, then wait for two consecutive 5‑min bars that close below VWAP (close < VWAP); enter long at the close of the second bar. Exit shape: Stop at the low of the gap bar or the day’s low; target at VWAP (or prior close) with a 1:1.5 risk‑reward, then trail using a chandelier exit (ATR×1.5). Regime hint: Ideal when VIX < 25 (moderate volatility) and time between 09:30‑11:30; avoid if the gap up exceeds 0.8% (risk of runaway).
